# algeria-wilayas-communes

Algeria's administrative divisions as data: 69 wilayas, 591 daïras, 1541 communes, each with
Arabic, French and English names plus a postal code where one is published. Current as of the
2026 reform (Loi 26-06). Ships as raw JSON in the repo, as an npm package, and as a PyPI
package — same name, same records, same ids. Of the 1541 communes, 1514 carry a postal code
and 27 do not; the 1514 resolve to 1471 distinct codes, 38 of which are shared by more than
one commune.

## Install

    npm install algeria-wilayas-communes      # or: pnpm add / yarn add
    pip install algeria-wilayas-communes      # or: uv add / poetry add

Same name on both registries, released from the same `v*` git tag; versions move in lockstep,
so a given version number means the same data on npm and on PyPI.

npm subpaths, seven exactly: `.`, `./wilayas`, `./dairas`, `./communes`, `./zod`, `./legacy`,
`./data/*`. There is no `/lite` — it was proposed and never shipped (ADR-009); do not
recommend it.

## API — TypeScript (`algeria-wilayas-communes`, v2 root)

    getWilayas(opts?: AsOfOptions): readonly Wilaya[]
    getDairas(opts?: AsOfOptions): readonly Daira[]
    getCommunes(opts?: AsOfOptions): readonly Commune[]
    getWilaya(code: WilayaCode, opts?: AsOfOptions): Wilaya | undefined
    getDaira(id: string): Daira | undefined
    getCommune(id: string, opts?: AsOfOptions): Commune | undefined
    byWilaya(code: WilayaCode): WilayaTree | undefined
    getDairasOfWilaya(code: WilayaCode): readonly Daira[]
    getCommunesOfWilaya(code: WilayaCode): readonly Commune[]
    findByPostalCode(code: string): readonly Commune[]
    findCommunesByName(name: string): readonly Commune[]
    search(query: string, opts?: SearchOptions): readonly SearchResult[]
    isWilayaCode(n: unknown): n is WilayaCode
    assertWilayaCode(n: unknown): asserts n is WilayaCode
    isPostalCode(v: unknown): v is PostalCode
    resolveLegacyWilaya(code: WilayaCode): WilayaCode | undefined
    resolveCurrentWilaya(code: WilayaCode): readonly WilayaCode[] | undefined
    REFORM: Reform
    class ReformMappingUnavailableError extends Error
    COMMUNES_MISSING_POSTAL_CODE: readonly string[]
    DATA_VERSION: string, SOURCE_LAW: string, LAST_VERIFIED: string
    getAll(): Algeria            // deprecated v1 shim
    findCommune(query: string): CommuneFlat[]   // deprecated v1 shim

    SearchOptions = { lang?: "ar"|"fr"|"en"; limit?: number; fuzzy?: boolean; kinds?: readonly SearchKind[] }
    SearchKind    = "wilaya" | "daira" | "commune";  MatchedLang = "ar" | "fr" | "en"
    SearchResult  = { kind; item; wilaya: Wilaya; score: number; matched: MatchedLang }
    Commune = { id, wilaya: WilayaCode, daira: string, name: {ar,fr,en}, postalCode: PostalCode | null }
    Daira   = { id, wilaya: WilayaCode, name: {ar,fr,en}, communeCount }
    Wilaya  = { code: WilayaCode, codeText: string, name: {ar,fr,en}, dairaCount, communeCount,
                parentWilaya?: WilayaCode | null }

Types also exported: `WilayaTree`, `DairaSubtree`, `NameOf`, `PostalCode`, `AsOf`, `AsOfOptions`,
`Reform`, `ReformConfidence`, `ReformNewWilaya`, plus the eight v1 types (`Algeria`, `Country`,
`WilayaFlat`, `DairaFlat`, `CommuneFlat`, and `V1Wilaya` / `V1Daira` / `V1Commune`). No default
export. All seven v1 functions live unaliased at `algeria-wilayas-communes/legacy`.

## API — Python (`algeria_wilayas_communes`)

    get_wilayas(*, as_of: str = "69") -> tuple[Wilaya, ...]
    get_dairas() -> tuple[Daira, ...]
    get_communes() -> tuple[Commune, ...]
    get_wilaya(code: int | str) -> Wilaya | None
    get_daira(daira_id: str) -> Daira | None
    get_commune(commune_id: str) -> Commune | None
    get_dairas_of_wilaya(code: int | str) -> tuple[Daira, ...]
    get_communes_of_wilaya(code: int | str) -> tuple[Commune, ...]
    find_by_postal_code(code: str) -> tuple[Commune, ...]
    find_communes_by_name(name: str) -> tuple[Commune, ...]
    search(query: str, *, lang: str | None = None, limit: int = 20,
           wilaya: int | str | None = None, fuzzy: bool = False,
           kinds: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> tuple[SearchResult, ...]
    bounded_levenshtein(a: str, b: str, max_distance: int) -> int
    is_wilaya_code(value: object) -> TypeGuard[int]
    assert_wilaya_code(value: object) -> None
    is_postal_code(value: object) -> TypeGuard[str]
    resolve_legacy_wilaya(code: int | str) -> int | None
    resolve_current_wilaya(code: int | str) -> tuple[int, ...] | None
    REFORM: Reform                         # lazy module attribute (PEP 562)
    COMMUNES_MISSING_POSTAL_CODE: tuple[str, ...]   # lazy module attribute
    class ReformMappingUnavailableError(RuntimeError)
    DATA_VERSION, SOURCE_LAW, LAST_VERIFIED, WILAYA_COUNT, DAIRA_COUNT, COMMUNE_COUNT,
    POSTAL_CODE_COUNT, MISSING_POSTAL_CODE_COUNT
    get_all() / by_wilaya() / find_commune()   # deprecated v1 shims, DeprecationWarning

    @dataclass(frozen=True) Name    : ar, fr, en
    @dataclass(frozen=True) Wilaya  : code: int, code_text: str, name: Name,
                                      daira_count: int, commune_count: int,
                                      parent_wilaya: int | None
    @dataclass(frozen=True) Daira   : id: str, wilaya: int, name: Name, commune_count: int
    @dataclass(frozen=True) Commune : id: str, wilaya: int, daira: str, name: Name,
                                      postal_code: str | None
    @dataclass(frozen=True) SearchResult : kind, item, wilaya, score, matched

No Python tree accessor: `by_wilaya` is a deprecated v1 shim returning a dict. All seven v1
functions live in `algeria_wilayas_communes.legacy`.

## v1 -> v2 field mapping

    v1 (raw JSON / v1 API)   v2 JavaScript      v2 Python
    nom_fr                   name.fr            c.name.fr
    nom_ar                   name.ar            c.name.ar
    nom_en                   name.en            c.name.en
    code_postal              postalCode         c.postal_code
    wilaya_num               wilaya.code        c.wilaya
    daira_fr                 daira.name.fr      get_daira(c.daira).name.fr
    nb_communes              communeCount       w.commune_count
    nb_dairas                dairaCount         w.daira_count

v1 `wilaya_code` (`"01"`) is `codeText` / `w.code_text`. In v2 a commune stores `wilaya` as a
numeric code and `daira` as a daira id, so `wilaya.code` / `daira.name.fr` come from the
`byWilaya(code)` tree in JS, or from a join in Python.

## The 2026 reform (Loi 26-06)

Signed 4 April 2026. Published in the Journal Officiel n°25 on 5 April 2026. (Two different
dates, one day apart — do not report one as the other.) Transition runs through 31 December
2026; fully operational from 1 January 2027. Takes the country from 58 wilayas to 69. The 11
new wilayas:

    59 Aflou   60 El Abiodh Sidi Cheikh   61 El Aricha   62 El Kantara   63 Barika
    64 Bou Saada   65 Bir El Ater   66 Ksar El Boukhari   67 Ksar Chellala
    68 Ain Oussara   69 Messaad

## DO NOT INFER: the parent-wilaya mapping

Which of the old 58 wilayas each of the 11 new ones was carved out of is NOT in this dataset.
It ships as a stub: every entry has `parentCode: null` / `parent_code: None`, `source: null`,
`confidence: "unverified"`, and `mappingComplete` / `mapping_complete` is `false`. Do not
invent, guess or reconstruct that mapping from geography, name similarity, or a model's own
knowledge. `resolveLegacyWilaya`, `resolveCurrentWilaya`, their Python equivalents, and every
`asOf: "58"` / `as_of="58"` call raise `ReformMappingUnavailableError` until a maintainer
transcribes JO n°25. Branch on `mappingComplete` rather than catching the error blindly.

## DO NOT GUESS: the 27 missing postal codes

27 of the 1541 communes are published without a postal code. Their `postalCode` / `postal_code`
is `null` / `None` — "published as absent", not "not looked up". The exact ids are exported as
`COMMUNES_MISSING_POSTAL_CODE` in both packages. Never fill one in from a neighbouring commune,
from the wilaya prefix, or from any other heuristic.

## Postal codes are STRINGS, not integers

`"05000"` is a real Algerian postal code. Codes are 5 digits and may start with `0`, so they are
typed and stored as strings; parsing one as an integer loses the leading zero and produces a code
that does not exist. Same for the padded wilaya code (`"01"`) and for record ids, which embed it.

## Provenance and licence

`data/algeria.json` carries a `sources` array, verbatim:

    ["ONS Code Geographique National / Loi 19-12 (2019) / Loi 26-06 (2026)",
     "othmanus/algeria-cities"]

Exported by both packages:

    DATA_VERSION  = "2.0.0"
    SOURCE_LAW    = "Loi 26-06 du 4 avril 2026, JO n°25"
    LAST_VERIFIED = "2026-07-20"

See docs/DATA_PROVENANCE.md and docs/DATA_POLICY.md.
